title: Tess Merkel & Martin Rolinski - Crucified Reborn (2026)

lines.l: Behavior, save my behavior
A lifetime
Out of the city, lightning, chasing every sound
Falling, but I'm rising, never touch the ground
I'll burn from paper, heaven's all but breaking free
Nothing left unspoken, this is who I'll be
Broken glass, we find you in the noise
Whisper through the sky, chasing golden doors
The moon from fading shadows, catch you in the light
Nothing feels like distance when you hold on tight
I cry, I pray, I pray, I pray, I pray, I pray, I pray
I'm crucified, crucified like my Savior
Sail like behavior, a lifetime of praise
I'm crucified for the holy dimension
God like ascension
Heavens away
Through crystal silence, painted skies on both
Puppets I've been reading, stories to be told
Before I end my grieving, dance into the night
Nothing feels like waiting when we hold on tight
I cry, I pray, I pray
I cry, I cry, I cry, won't you? Won't you? Won't you?
I'm crucified, crucified like my Savior
Save life behavior, a lifetime of grace
I'm crucified for the holy dimension
God like ascension
Heaven's away
Dating through fiery flames
A lifetime of praise
I'm crucified
For the holy dimension
God-like ascension
Heaven's away
